description: Read Cardano blockchain data through Koios, Cardano's community-run public API: ADA balances, transactions and tokens of an address or a whole wallet, staking rewards and delegation, transactions and their confirmations, blocks and epochs, native tokens and NFTs with their holders, stake pools and their history, the ADA supply, and governance proposals. A trigger runs on each new transaction of an address or wallet. No account or API key required.

koios_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs for each new transaction of a Cardano address, or of any address of a wallet given by its stake address, with the ADA received and sent and its message. Checks every five minutes or so; transactions made before the workflow is turned on never run it.

output.address: The address or stake address watched.
output.address_type: address, or stake_address for a whole wallet.
output.block_height: The number of the block it is in.
output.block_time: When it was made, ISO 8601 UTC.
output.block_time_unix: When it was made, as Unix seconds.
output.direction: received, or sent when the wallet spent or withdrew rewards in it.
output.epoch_no: The epoch it was made in.
output.from_address: For money received, the address it came from.
output.net_ada: How the wallet's ADA changed: negative when it paid out.
output.net_lovelace: The same change, exactly, in lovelace.
output.received_ada: ADA paid to the wallet in it.
